01 / Furniture

Clarity across products,
pieces, and locations.

THE OPERATIONAL CHALLENGE

Furniture operations need to distinguish individual pieces, complete sets, fabrics, and stock locations without losing the identity of each item.

THE SYSTEM RESPONSE

A dedicated furniture workflow with product and warehouse management, customer records, and sales orders. Product and piece identification supports the business's inventory structure.

02 / Fish trading & distribution

A clear path from
order to collection.

THE OPERATIONAL CHALLENGE

Sales, finance, fulfillment, and delivery need a shared order status, with clear responsibility at every handover.

THE SYSTEM RESPONSE

A staged sales workflow covering finance approval, customer confirmation, fulfillment, delivery, invoicing, and payment status, supported by role-based permissions and customer records.

03 / Gym management

Memberships and attendance,
under control.

THE OPERATIONAL CHALLENGE

Daily member check-ins need accurate records, protection against duplicate attendance entries, and controlled access for staff.

THE SYSTEM RESPONSE

A membership and attendance system with member search, subscription records, duplicate-day prevention, staff permissions, and scheduled attendance archiving with an audit view.
